title: Impact of Regional Carbon Pricing on CO2 Emissions
research_question: Does the adoption of regional carbon pricing policies lead to a reduction in CO2 emissions per capita? By comparing regions with and without carbon pricing over time, we aim to identify the causal effect of these policies on emissions.
data_description: The dataset includes 200 observations with columns: unit_id (region identifier), period (time period), treated (indicator for regions with carbon pricing), post (indicator for periods after policy implementation), treat_x_post (interaction term for treated regions post-policy), and y (log CO2 emissions per capita).
